entries.title: Saigon Skyline Chess
entries.summary: A geometry-readable orthodox chess set that turns six Ho Chi Minh City landmarks into a complete 32-piece skyline, with round River and square Grid plinths distinguishing the two sides without relying on color.

entries.title: Cradle Crescent
entries.summary: Cradle Crescent is a palm-sized, one-piece crescent desk rocker with two choose-either horn tap pockets and an integral centered star; it is designed for a gentle lateral tap and a point-up rest cue.

entries.title: Lunar Relay
entries.summary: A palm-sized, three-part printable desk mechanism whose exposed rocker makes one cratered moon rise when the other is pressed.

entries.title: Orbit Gobbler
entries.summary: An all-printable hand-cranked desktop automaton in which a geared carrier guides a captive moon through a visible orbit and back through a fixed C-shaped mouth every two crank turns.

entries.title: Eclipse Braid
entries.summary: A one-handed print-in-place desk toy whose captive moon runner follows one fully visible braided figure-eight route through two separated bridges and returns home by continued thumb motion.

entries.title: Comet Heist: Twin-Pulse Vault Run
entries.summary: A portable, all-printed tabletop dexterity game for one or two players: pulse two gravity gates, flick a comet through both portals, and bank into pip-marked vaults across six shots.

entries.title: False Lantern
entries.summary: A compact two-player firefly signaling duel invented by Leo and completed by the Codex-orchestrated Workshop flow: Wish → Match → Invent → Make ↔ Playtest → Release.

entries.title: Moonwake Garden
entries.summary: A pocket-sized, three-part ambient-light garden whose single exposed right-edge dial reveals Cassiopeia, Cygnus, and a Little Dipper reading within Ursa Minor at three indexed positions.

entries.title: Moonwake Turn
entries.summary: A one-piece desk sculpture whose sailing-ship silhouette becomes a breaching-whale and crescent-moon aperture after one exact quarter-turn.

entries.title: Storm Reveal
entries.summary: A pocket-size three-piece sleepy cloud puzzle whose single guided quarter-turn reveals a standing rainbow-and-lightning storm scene, then reverses to reset.

entries.title: Frosting Aloft
entries.summary: A two-part printable cupcake whose lifted frosting transforms its wall shadow into a hot-air balloon.

entries.title: Lantern Menagerie: The Three-Moon Shadow Reel
entries.summary: A four-part hand-powered moon gate with a captured reel that casts indexed rabbit, fox, and owl shadows from an ordinary external phone flashlight.

entries.title: Pocket Eclipse Menagerie
entries.summary: A palm-sized one-piece shadow toy whose broad faces project a horned owl and, after a 90-degree turn, a leaping rabbit under an ordinary external phone flashlight.

entries.title: Comet Pebble
entries.summary: A palm-size one-piece desk wobbler designed for a sideways flick or gentle roll, with a raised smiling-star home cue.

entries.title: Horn Tip
entries.summary: A tiny one-piece crescent desk rocker. Press a rounded horn with a fingertip and it tips, then gravity walks it back to rest on its outer curve.

entries.title: Moonchase Fox
entries.summary: A palm-sized, one-piece sleeping fox whose curled tail is a gentle desk-rocking track around a crescent window.

entries.title: Mooncoil Dragon
entries.summary: A palm-sized one-piece desk rocker designed to rest as a curled sleeping dragon, then reveal a castle-bearing crescent when gently rocked.

entries.title: Neststomp
entries.summary: A palm-sized two-piece owl desk toy whose removable chick rolls beneath the belly to create a visible foot-to-foot change.

entries.title: Orbit Cradle
entries.summary: A palm-sized, one-piece crescent moon that rocks on one continuous arc while its joined star appears to climb, crest, and return.

entries.title: Pearlturn
entries.summary: A two-piece hand-powered desk toy whose open clam shell is intended to shift between low and tall poses around a loose, visible pearl drum.

entries.title: Starling Gate
entries.summary: A palm-sized, one-piece rocking arch whose negative space shifts from a perched bird at rest toward a shooting-star streak in motion.

entries.title: Tempest Lull
entries.summary: A palm-sized, one-piece storm-cloud desk rocker whose connected lightning bolt sweeps through the open arch as the whole body rocks and returns toward center.

entries.title: Ember Knock
entries.summary: One-piece table-edge lantern rocker for rigid 18–22 mm edges, with a rounded throat, underside striker, twin return pads, and inboard globe ballast.

entries.title: Rainspell Dial: Three-Field Sound Garden
entries.summary: A palm-size, hand-powered desktop sound toy whose broad wheel carries a captive rounded gravity plectrum across three visibly different printed rib fields in the continuous sequence rain, frog-song, and crickets.

entries.title: Night-Sky Weave
entries.summary: Nine reversible Crescent, Comet, and Star tiles share centered edge gates, inviting loose mosaic play as snowflakes, dragons, crowns, and newly named constellations.

entries.title: Moon-Moth Bloom
entries.summary: A three-part, hardware-free hand-powered desk toy: sweeping the left wing rotates the meshed pair from a low crescent form toward a moth silhouette with six star apertures.
